stops.note: to place across, to move, from trans- (across) and ponere (to place)
carried into French for changing the order or position of things
stops.meaning: to change the order or position of things

stops.note: settled as the English word for switching the position or order of two things
stops.meaning: to switch the position or order of two things

current_meaning: to switch the position or order of two or more things, or to change the key of music
